whyItMatters: A CORS wildcard lets any website read cross-origin responses, so a single convincing link can exfiltrate data tied to the victim's session or ambient credentials.
actions: Replace "*" with an explicit allowlist of trusted origins.
Never combine a wildcard with allow_credentials.
Re-run a SAST scan after the fix and confirm DPK-SAST-017 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and no credentialed endpoint serves a wildcard origin.
